# help removefilesystem
removefilesystem - remove a filesystem from the system

SYNTAX
    removefilesystem [options] <name>

DESCRIPTION
    The removefilesystem command removes the filesystem from the system.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the filesystem_remove right

OPTIONS
    -f
        Specifies that the command is forced. If this option is not used, the
        command requires confirmation before proceeding with its operation.

SPECIFIERS
    <name>
        Specifies a filesystem name to be removed.

NOTES
    Issuing the removefilesystem command with invalid filesystem name causes the
    command to exit without removing any filesystem.

    Issuing the removefilesystem command if fileshare is present on it will fail the command.

    Verify the removal of filesystem by issuing the showfilesystem command.

EXAMPLES
    The following example removes filesystem demo_fs

       cli% removefilesystem demo_fs
